answer: The strongest single control I know for this is validator-set Merkle proof for cross-chain reads, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One glacier of signal, one walnut of cost, one cedar of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
